name: Spellogger
description:
About This Game

EXPLORE A DENSE OPEN WORLD

A small but dense land filled with things to do and explore. Plenty of secret items scattered throughout the world will aid your journey into becoming the best Wizard Lumberjack the Dale has ever seen. Think Skyrim-like exploration combined with day to day tasks like Stardew Valley.

BUILD AND CULTIVATE YOUR HOMESTEAD

Restore your run-down home and build new work benches to unlock crafting options. Plant crops, tend your garden through the seasons, and fish for food and trade goods. Become stronger by eating good food, drinking magical potions and taking a good night sleep with proper lumber burning in your fireplace.

EXPERIENCE INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION IN A COZY FIRST-PERSON RPG

Level up through exploration and tasks. Master skill-trees like Lumbermancy, Sawmanism, Barkane Magic and many more, each unlocking unique powers! Every few hours of play, you'll feel noticeably stronger.

AID NEIGHBORS IN ELDER SCROLLS-STYLE QUESTLINES

Accept multi-strage questlines from NPCs with real personalities, motivations and storylines. Learn about the mysterious land called the Dale in where you find yourself living, live your life in this seemingly perfect world in which you mysteriously woke up in.
short_desc: The first ever life-sim RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack! Fell trees with your axe and magic. Explore a quiet world full of secrets, help villagers with their troubles, and steadily grow stronger as you gather resources and take down more trees.
